name: Seaweed salad
summary: Seaweed from the reefs, including the rocks at gành Đá Đĩa. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 17 June 2021 article soaks it in fresh water, trims it, and sets it with herbs, shredded coconut, chopped mango, lime, peanuts, and sesame rice crackers. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Yen. The reefs at gành Đá Đĩa, on Du lịch Phú Yên’s 17 June 2021 article.
howToEat: Soak the fresh seaweed in fresh water, wash it, cut off the base, and cut it to chopstick size. Set it with sliced herbs, shredded coconut, chopped mango, a slice of lime, and roasted peanuts.

Break a sesame rice cracker, add the seaweed and the rest to a bowl, and spoon on mắm chua ngọt or plain fish sauce pounded with green chilli. The article says a vegetarian plate can use soy sauce instead. A price is Check on arrival. An hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The seaweed grows on the reefs and rock shelves. The 17 June 2021 article names gành Đá Đĩa. A restaurant street was not printed. Check on arrival.
